description: List the skills visible to the caller in a workspace: the caller's own, every skill shared with the workspace, every public one, and any `members` skill that names the caller. `visibility` says which tier each is: personal ("Only me"), members (named people), shared (the workspace), public (anyone with the link). [Full notes: get_started section "TOOL NOTES list_skills"]
